maddeler.e:
يرثعن (form IVq)
# يَرْثَعِنُّ (yarṯaʕinnu) /jar.θa.ʕin.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْثَعَنَّ (irṯaʕanna)
# يَرْثَعِنَّ (yarṯaʕinna) /jar.θa.ʕin.na/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْثَعَنَّ (irṯaʕanna)
# يَرْثَعِنِّ (yarṯaʕinni) /jar.θa.ʕin.ni/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِرْثَعَنَّ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
